title: Saathi
tagline: Your guide for studies, careers and money
greetingBody: I am Saathi. Ask me about careers, scholarships, colleges or exams. You can speak or type.
homeBody: Speak or type your question. Saathi shows the answer as simple cards.
homeLead: Here is what Saathi found for you. Ask anything new below.

error: Saathi could not answer just now. Please try again.
loadError: This old chat could not be opened. Please try again later.
offline: Saathi needs internet to talk. Your Careers and Scholarships pages still work without it.
offlineShort: You are offline. Saathi will work again when you are online.
pastChatsBody: Open an old chat to continue it.
answered: I answered your question. Please continue.
actionFailed: That did not work. Please check your internet and try again.
